claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 436 seconds, which is longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the driver's evidence and the dwell requirement does not defeat the fee.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:26:22 and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same timestamp, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) and limb (b) are both met and the arrival is not a false marker under POL-NS-05.

The trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 21:33:39, after the 436-second dwell had elapsed, and no boarding event is recorded, so POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied.

The fare ledger shows a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50 and no waiting-time line, which reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and the amount charged is the correct net figure.

The rider's own device track places the rider roughly 800 m from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD zones, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed and the rider-contact clause cannot exonerate the rider.

The chat log holds a single driver message at 21:26:42 stating he is at the pickup point, read by the rider at 21:27:12, and the rider sent nothing during the waiting window, so POL-NS-04 limb (a) is not met either.
The driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius rather than outside it, so POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance analysis does not apply and the fee is not displaced by that clause.

The rider's cancellation was not the trigger here - the driver terminated the trip - so POL-NS-10's grace and waiting-time limbs do not bear on this fee, and the only route to a refund would be a POL-NS-02 to POL-NS-06 displacement, none of which is made out.

The driver's anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075, below the 0.08 rate, so compensation is payable rather than withheld under POL-NS-07.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and no disputes with this counterparty in the trailing 90 days, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) escalation trigger is engaged on the rider side.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals can be claimed - but the single 436-second run already exceeds the 180-second minimum, so the shortfall clause does not assist the rider in any event.

The rider's claim that the driver 'cancelled on me again' is not supported by the record: the trace shows the driver arrived, held position for over seven minutes, and messaged the rider, and the rider's device never came within 100 m of the pin, so the present charge should stand.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:26:22 and a wait timer started two seconds later, and the driver terminated the trip at 21:33:39 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event anywhere in the record. Limb (a) and limb (d) of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied on the platform's own telemetry.

The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m for a continuous qualifying run of 436 seconds, from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38, across 45 qualifying fixes. That is well past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip, so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied with 256 seconds to spare.

The arrival marker is not false. The trace shows the driver stationary at the pickup point from the moment of the 'I'm Here' tap, with a minimum distance to the pin of 0.11 m and a dwell start offset of 0.0 seconds, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and the waiting clock runs from the arrival event exactly as the record states.

The driver did not sit silent: he sent an in-app message at 21:26:42 reading 'im at the pickup point', which the rider read at 21:27:12. The rider never replied and never appeared. The rider's own device track shows 76 fixes with a minimum distance of 797.9 m from the pickup pin and zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider presence radius, so the rider was not at the pickup point during the waiting window.

The rider's track never comes within 400 m of the pin, so this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case under POL-NS-03 and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The driver was at the correct registered pickup point, VEN-JW-ST61, and the rider was roughly 800 m away from it.

The fare ledger reconciles: the cancellation fee line is SGD 4.50, which equals the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) and the charge is the correct net figure.

The anti-farming check under POL-NS-07 does not trip. The driver's no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.075, below the 0.08 rate. Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld, and neither does, so the driver is entitled to 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, being SGD 3.60.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's disputes_with_counterparty_90d is also 0, so neither escalation trigger (c) nor (d) of POL-NS-09 is engaged and this case is decidable without human review.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING and carries weight 0.0. I do not rely on it, and I note it only to record that no advisory could have excused a shortfall here, because there is no shortfall: the dwell exceeded the minimum by 256 seconds.

The rider's claim that the driver 'cancelled on me again' is not supported by this record. The driver arrived, waited 436 seconds inside the arrival radius, messaged the rider, and cancelled only after the free waiting period had long expired. The charge stands and the driver is owed his compensation.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the record supports this no-show charge, the rider's SGD 4.50 fee stands and is not refunded, and the platform pays the driver SGD 3.60.

Arrival and dwell (POL-NS-01). The trip record shows driver DRV-09728 tapping 'I'm Here' at 21:26:22 and the 180-second wait timer starting at 21:26:24. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02728) places him inside the STANDARD-zone arrival radius of 50 m of the pin on a single continuous qualifying run of 436 seconds, from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38, across 45 qualifying fixes, with a closest approach of 0.11 m. That is 256 seconds more than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). Limbs (a), (b) and (c) are therefore met, and no_show_threshold_sec is null so no longer threshold applies. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the marker the driver was stationary at the pin, neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above; the recomputed clock therefore starts where the record says it does. The driver cancelled at 21:33:39 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed and with no boarding event anywhere in the record, so limb (d) is met.

No displacing clause. POL-NS-02 is satisfied, since qualifying in-radius fixes exist, so it does not refund the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes were inside the 50 m radius, not outside it, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02728) holds one message and it is the driver's ('im at the pickup point', sent 21:26:42, read 21:27:12); the rider sent nothing in the waiting window, so limb (a) fails, and the rider's device track shows zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius with a closest fix 797.9 m from the pin, so limb (c) fails too. POL-NS-06 does not apply: the 436-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall and nothing to refund; the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02728-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is irrelevant for that reason, and neither side may use it, so the two claims that cited it without naming its issue code were discarded by the referee. POL-NS-10 does not apply: the driver, not the rider, terminated the trip.

The fee and the payout. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02728) charges a single cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 and no waiting-time line, reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare-integrity defect and the amount charged is the correct net figure. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80% of that net fee: SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip, because both limbs must hold and the first does not: no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (below 4) and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075 (below 0.08). No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires: the deciding facts rest on artifacts at full weight 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace), so confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell; no counterparty disputes appear in the trailing 90 days; and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. Nothing in the driver or rider profile is used as a ground of decision.

Both advocates' surviving claims on the four limbs, the fare integrity, the false-arrival test and the anti-farming check are accepted and lead to this outcome. The rider's claim that the driver 'cancelled on me again' is not supported on this record. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue; the disputed SGD 4.50 charge is left as it is, and SGD 3.60 is paid to the driver.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02728 stands unchanged, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 of it.

WHY THE FEE STANDS. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only where all four conditions hold, and on this record they do. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-02728) carries the driver's 'I'm Here' arrival event at 21:26:22. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02728) puts him at the pickup pin - minimum distance 0.11 m - with 45 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius required by POL-NS-02, the first of them at 21:26:22, the same moment as the tap. That also disposes of POL-NS-05: the arrival marker was not false (he was at the pin, stationary, at the marker's timestamp), so the waiting clock runs from 21:26:22 exactly as the record states. (c) He then held position continuously from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38 - 436 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in this trip's own platform_policy - which is 256 seconds more than the minimum, so POL-NS-06's shortfall clause has nothing to bite on. (d) No boarding event is recorded and the driver terminated the trip at 21:33:39 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed.

WHAT DOES NOT DISPLACE THE FEE. POL-NS-03 is the wrong-entrance clause and does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it, so there is no wrong-face-of-the-building case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider, and the chat log (EV-CHAT-02728) holds only the driver's message at 21:26:42, 'im at the pickup point', read at 21:27:12 - the rider sent nothing during the waiting window. Independently, the rider's own 76-fix device track never comes closer than 797.9 m to the pin (mean 802.0 m), so limb (c) fails on its merits as well; and POL-NS-11 would not change the result even if that limb were treated as unrunnable, because the fee would then be decided on the driver's evidence, which is complete. POL-NS-10 concerns cancellations the rider makes; this trip was terminated by the driver, so its grace and waiting-time limbs do not bear on this fee. On integrity (POL-NS-08): the fare line of SGD 4.50 equals the platform_policy cancellation fee in force, so limb (d) finds no fare defect; the arrival timestamp matches a GPS fix at zero offset, there are no sampling gaps (0.0 s maximum gap, 100 per cent coverage, 87 driver fixes), and the chat log is complete against the record's own message count, so nothing is impaired.

THE MONEY. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force - SGD 3.60 - the residual SGD 0.90 being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075, below the 0.08 rate; both limbs must be met before compensation is withheld, and neither is. The ruling is therefore DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 - that is the amount the ruling moves, not a second payment, and no refund goes to the rider. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so under POL-GEN-05 it executes automatically on issue.

ESCALATION AND REFERRALS. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the trip record and the GPS trace agree on arrival and dwell rather than contradicting each other; neither party shows disputes with the other counterparty in the trailing 90 days; the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08. No clause produces a referral here: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was true, and POL-NS-07's escalation packet does not arise because the anti-farming check is clear.

CONFIDENCE. 0.95. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - the trip record (EV-TRIP-02728) and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02728) - carries weight_multiplier 1.0 and is unimpaired, so the cap is 1.0; the absent traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02728-01 at weight 0.0, carries no fact in this ruling.

TO THE RIDER: your statement that the driver 'cancelled on me again' is not borne out by this record. The driver came to your registered pickup point at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61, waited over seven minutes inside the arrival radius and messaged you, while your own device remained about 800 m away and you sent no reply and no locating message. This provisional ruling may be appealed once, within 30 days, under POL-GEN-04. TO THE DRIVER: the SGD 3.60 is payable and the charge stands.

NOTE ON DISCARDED MATERIAL. Two claims about the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02728-01) were discarded at the mechanical citation check because each cited an artifact of weight 0.0 without naming its issue code (MISSING_ARTIFACT). Nothing in this ruling turns on the advisory - it is absent and carries no fact. Driver profile fields other than no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d, including the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter of 7, are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground of decision.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 out of it. To the driver: you are compensated SGD 3.60; that figure is the amount this ruling moves under POL-GEN-03, not a refund to the rider.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. You tapped 'I'm Here' at 21:26:22 (EV-TRIP-02728), and the GPS trace independently puts you at the pickup pin (EV-GPS-02728): the closest fix is 0.11 m from it, you were stationary there, and you held position continuously for 436 seconds, from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38, across 45 qualifying fixes. The free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the required dwell was met with 256 seconds to spare, and the trip was terminated at 21:33:39 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold.

CLAIMS AGAINST THE FEE, ANSWERED. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05: at the arrival timestamp you were stationary and effectively on the pin, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 km/h or more, so the waiting clock was not recomputed. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; there are no repeat disputes between these parties; and the anti-farming check does not trip.

ON THE RIDER'S OWN WORDS. 'Cancelled on me again' is not supported by this record, and the driver's lifetime no-show counter (7) is a context-only field under POL-GEN-01 that may not be used against him; the trailing-30-day figure a clause may read is 3, and it is below its threshold. Two claims about the missing traffic advisory were discarded in the citation check for not naming its issue code, and they change nothing here.

The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05 and executes automatically, subject to the appeal route in POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this is a verified rider no-show. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 out of it. Because the outcome is driver compensation, amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd both carry the same SGD 3.60 - that is the money this ruling moves, per POL-GEN-03, and it is not a second payment or a refund to the filing rider.

What the record shows (EV-TRIP-02728, EV-GPS-02728). The trip record logs the driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 21:26:22, a wait timer two seconds later, and the driver's cancellation at 21:33:39 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event anywhere. The GPS trace - 100% coverage, 10-second fixes, no gaps - places the driver at the pin, closest fix 0.11 m, from 21:26:22 to 21:33:38: a continuous in-geofence run of 436 seconds across 45 qualifying fixes, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold: (a) the arrived event exists; (b) the trace puts the driver inside the geofence at that event's own timestamp; (c) the dwell, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap, is 436 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force under platform_policy.free_wait_sec, a surplus of 256 s; and (d) the driver terminated the trip under RIDER_NO_SHOW after that dwell elapsed.

What was argued, and how it is answered. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at 21:26:22 the driver was stationary at the pin, not more than 300 m away and not moving at 15 km/h, so no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-02's proximity test is satisfied, and the dispute turns on dwell, which is met. POL-NS-03 does not apply - the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the only chat message (EV-CHAT-02728) is the driver's own at 21:26:42, read at 21:27:12, and the rider sent nothing, so limb (a) fails; the rider's own device track also never comes closer than 797.9 m to the pin, so limb (c) is failed as well - and even if limb (c) were treated as undecidable under POL-NS-11, limb (a) alone denies exoneration. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to work on, and POL-NS-10 does not apply because the driver, not the rider, terminated the trip. The rider's assertion that the driver 'cancelled on me again' is not supported by this record; the lifetime counters on either profile are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no finding here.

The money. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02728) shows a single cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 and a total charged of SGD 4.50, equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80% of that net fee: SGD 3.60, the residual 20% being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip - no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (the threshold is 4 or more) and 3 divided by 40 completed trips is 0.075 (the threshold is above 0.08), and both limbs are required to withhold - so compensation is paid rather than withheld, and no escalation follows.

The traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02728-01) is MISSING and carries weight 0.0. Nothing in this ruling rests on it: POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unnecessary because the single 436-second run already exceeds the minimum by 256 s, so its absence changes no outcome. The two claims that cited it were discarded by the referee because they did not name its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code (see the audit record); they are not reinstated and they change nothing either way.

Confidence and next steps. Confidence is 0.95: every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-TRIP-02728, EV-GPS-02728, EV-FARE-02728) sits at weight 1.0, none of them is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) (no clock skew, no trace gap, no chat defect, fee reconciles), and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met - this case is decidable without human review. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld, and neither does, so the driver is entitled to 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, being SGD 3.60.
